SpaceX targets September 22 for Starship's first orbital flight carrying 26 V3 Starlink satellites. USSF-259 scrubbed at Vandenberg, retargeted Wednesday. SpaceX has set September 22 for Starship Flight 14, its first attempt to reach orbit. The mission will carry 26 V3 Starlink satellites to 275 km altitude, with the ship planned to complete six orbits over roughly ten hours before a Pacific splashdown west of Chile.
